data.name: Dissolution's Child
data.description: Once per day, you may change your appearance to look as if you were little more than a 4-foot-tall area of shadow. Your physical form still exists and you are not incorporeal--only your appearance changes. This works like invisibility, except it only lasts rounds (1 round per level, maximum 5 rounds). This is a supernatural ability. This racial trait replaces shadow magic.
